model_messages.content: Audit every named physical input in this exact typed ledger, including literal SI coordinate values. Do not substitute the correct definition or a KB vector for a wrong candidate and then claim PASSED. Return ledger_sha256 and each csv_name exactly once; before_si_exponents must copy the actual candidate. PASSED confirms the actual vector, CONFLICT requires a complete corrected suggested vector, and UNCERTAIN does not permit numerical execution. KB_RECORD requires actual entry_id citations from that variable's retrieved records. Canonical entity names are read by the program from the selected IDs; do not echo another quantity-name field. Your reason must explain why each cited record applies to this variable in the original problem, not merely why its vector matches. Cited vectors must support all known coordinates of the proposed/confirmed SI vector. INTERNAL_REASONING uses no IDs and must explain the physical meaning. Retrieval rank is relevance, not truth.
